slides.title: Collaboration metrics moved in both directions
slides.takeaway: Faster reviews and more focus time, but new hires take 4 days longer to land their first change [1]

slides.title: Satisfaction rose for everyone except new joiners
bullets: Tenured staff gained 0.5 points on average [2]
New joiners lost 0.5 points, citing fewer informal touchpoints [2]
slides.takeaway: Onboarding is the one group where hybrid work made things worse

slides.title: Keep hybrid, fix onboarding
pros: Delivery flat, cost down a quarter [1][3]
Focus time up 0.7 hours a day [2]
71% of staff prefer the current model [2]
cons: First PR takes 4 days longer for new hires [1]
slides.takeaway: The evidence supports keeping hybrid work with a dedicated onboarding fix

slides.title: Recommendations
bullets: Keep the 2 to 3 office-day model; revisit in Q2 2027
Pair every new hire with an on-site buddy for the first 4 weeks
Cap recurring cross-team meetings and review the calendar quarterly
slides.takeaway: Decision requested: approve the onboarding buddy program for Q1 2027
